name: unsafe fn pre_exec < F > (& mut self , f : F) -> & mut process :: Command where F : FnMut () -> io :: Result < () > + Send + Sync + 'static
rule: The caller must ensure that f is safe to run in the child process after fork, including compliance with applicable async-signal-safety requirements. Operations such as malloc, accessing environment variables through std::env, and acquiring a mutex are not guaranteed to be safe in this context.
api: trait CommandExt  : Sealed { unsafe fn pre_exec < F > (& mut self , f : F) -> & mut process::Command where F : FnMut () -> io::Result < () > + Send + Sync + 'static }
expression: This requirement cannot be expressed in the supplied DSL, which has no predicate for post-fork execution safety or async-signal-safety compliance.
